item.question: What is the purpose of using the Discriminability Index (DI) in analyzing rhyming word pairs?
item.answer: The Discriminability Index (DI) is used to determine how well a probability model can distinguish between rhyming word pairs by calculating the average risk at an optimal decision boundary. This helps in assessing whether a given word is more likely to be on the left or right based on certain features.
